onboarding.body: G3MStudio edits GameMaker games: sprites, rooms, code, sounds and more. It also builds mods and patches. Every choice can be changed later.
onboarding.later: You can change the language later in Settings > Appearance, and open this window again from Help > Getting Started.

explorer.text: Every resource of the game is here, grouped by type. Press Ctrl+P to jump to any resource by name.

tabs.text: A single click previews a resource in an italic tab. Edit it or double-click to keep it.

inspector.title: See what is selected
inspector.text: The Inspector shows the type and name of the selected resource, how many places use it, and the layers of the room in front.

palette.title: Every command is searchable
palette.text: Press Ctrl+Shift+P to search every command. The menus show the shortcuts.

problems.title: See what went wrong
problems.text: Warnings and errors from loading, saving and compiling collect here. Double-click one to jump to it.

save.title: Safe saving, quick testing
save.text: Save writes a new file and keeps a backup. Run Game starts the game with your changes without touching the original.

scripts.title: Run script
scripts.confirm:
Run {name}?

A script can change anything in the data file and can read and write any file on this computer. The change cannot be undone; Revert to Saved is the way back. Only run scripts you trust.

This runs UndertaleModTool-style .csx scripts, but only part of that tool's functions exist here: Data, FilePath, ScriptPath, ScriptMessage, ScriptWarning, ScriptError and ScriptQuestion (answered yes). Scripts that need dialogs, the decompiler helpers or the UI stop with a compile error that names the missing function.
